sources.title: Merotelic kinetochore attachment: causes and effects
sources.locator: Attachment geometries and checkpoint consequences: amphitelic, sisters attached to opposite poles; monotelic, one sister attached; syntelic, both sisters to one pole; merotelic, one kinetochore connected to both poles. Merotelic attachments do not trigger a checkpoint-dependent delay of anaphase onset, because merotelic and amphitelic attachments both generate tension across sisters and produce no unattached kinetochores. Aurora B is enriched at merotelic sites.
